fields.description: The clock time. Reached once the last punch is at or after it.

fields.description: Tick for a time after midnight, such as 01:00 the next morning. It belongs to the shift day that started before it.
fields.label: Next Day

fields.description: The TOTAL quarters of a day this band earns, not an increase on the row above. A quarter is a quarter of a day's pay.
